coaching.headline: A 43-minute loss decided on the map — towers 6-11 and every Primal Fangtooth went to them. The long game slipped, not the draft.
coaching.team: We traded the early neutrals fairly evenly, but late they kept taking the Primal Fangtooths and traded the 39.5 fight for Orb Prime across the map, and out-towered us 11-6. That's a closing/teamfight problem, not an itemization one — anti-heal was covered (2 vs a single healer). Win the late setpieces or end before them.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Group for the late Primes as a five — that's where the towers and the game went.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Adele support into Mourn, 1/10/12 — behind at every checkpoint, with the only spike (Vainglory ~28m) far too late to matter. None of the ten deaths were solo catches — they came in fights the macro flags as wrong starts while the support was pinned (17, 18.1, 29.6) — and 86888 mitigated says Mr_Meat31 was soaking the front of them. The fix is the team's fight selection and an earlier spike, not facechecks.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Legion carry, 13/5/5 and team-high 55k — the Sparrow lane was theirs at every checkpoint, but Goldilocks324 got the Sky Splitter spike early (~12m) and farmed through it. Fine pick, it carried the scoreboard; the loss was the team's late map, not Goldilocks324's lane. Funnel that damage into the late Primes the team was losing.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Zinx mid into Gideon was theirs at every checkpoint and the Oathkeeper spike (~19m) was Cuban Noobster's only real power timing — an unfavored, uphill lane. Good enabling (14 assists), but Cuban skipped armor into a 3-physical comp; build it to survive the late fights.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Shinbi offlane was a favored matchup that Willy Guggenheim took over, but the spikes came late (Oathkeeper ~31m, Oblivion Crown ~37m) and the line went 3/7 — and the macro flagged Willy alive-and-ahead but absent at the 13.6, 20.9, 27.3 and 36.4 fights; a shove-and-rotate there flips those numbers. Hold the won lane more patiently until the items land, then bring the lead to the fights.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Khaimera jungle into Bayle, 7/11/6 — Xeebs' early then even after, so the lead was real before it faded, and eleven deaths fed their map control. When the team is losing towers in the late game, stop committing to fights and finish the core (no Basilisk/Rapture) before re-engaging.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Mourn Abduct (pull), Bayle Kingslayer (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Mourn. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 2 items of it.
Dive threat on our backline: Yurei. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Adele, Zinx) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Ricochet stun → Bad Medicine zone → Infuse heal an ally → Neural Regenesis revive
ourKits.winCondition: keep an ally alive with Infuse + the revive ult and poke with Ricochet
ourKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
ourKits.playAgainst: she can't heal herself — dive HER; bait the revive before committing

ourKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes → Line Tempo wolves → Circle Rhythm shield → All-Kill! wolfpack ult
ourKits.winCondition: stack Track and unleash All-Kill! in a grouped fight
ourKits.playAgainst: spread vs the wolfpack; she's squishy without her shield up

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Anima Burst / Whispering Echoes apply Soul Rip → Severance resets on Soul-Ripped targets → Soulstorm pulls them in
enemyKits.winCondition: chain Severance resets to stick to a target and burst in melee
enemyKits.passive: casting grants ranged empowered basics + attack speed
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up CC to hold the target she dashes onto
enemyKits.playAgainst: her chain needs Soul Rip resets — peel/disengage breaks it; punish when Severance is on cooldown

enemyKits.combo: Abduct pull → Contagion ally-heal bugs → Beguile damage-reduction → Eclipse vision-denial ult
enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and sustain the team through the brawl
enemyKits.playWith: burst that punishes his pulled target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect the long Abduct channel/range; anti-heal blunts Contagion

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
enemyKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
enemyKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
enemyKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

enemyKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
enemyKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
enemyKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
enemyKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
enemyKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down

enemyKits.combo: Skull Crusher gap-close → Dire Howl slow → Cursed Edge → Kingslayer knockback dash, Berserk at low HP
enemyKits.winCondition: engage, drop low into Berserk and out-brawl
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up while he commits the dive
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Berserk rewards low HP — burst him fully or disengage; anti-heal helps

sparrow.loadout: Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity), augment Sun Shards, crest Eviscerator
lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,737 hero damage a minute, more than 98% of Sparrow carry players this patch (29% of the team's). The damage came from Lightning Hawk, Tainted Rounds, Viper.
Inner Fire at rank 3: 105s base, about 95.5s by the end (9% shorter) from 10 ability haste: Spectra 10.
Sparrow dealt 74,710 hero damage, 29% of their team's, with +217 physical power from items.

Penetration: Viper 8, Vanquisher 12; against Adele (level 18: about 365 physical armor, 345 after penetration; took 26,879 physical damage from heroes, 43% of all hero damage they took) and Khaimera (level 18: about 138 physical armor, 118 after penetration; took 36,347 physical damage from heroes, 52% of all hero damage they took) that is about 4% and 9% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Lightning Hawk (item): While moving or landing Basic Attacks: Generate stacks of Momentum. At 100 stacks empower your next Basic Attack On-Hit. Deal 40 (+20%) Damage. Slows by 20% for 0.75s.
Tainted Rounds (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.
Viper (item): Against Eroded Heroes: Deal 10% increased On-Hit and Ability damage.
Eviscerator (crest): Gain 20% Attack Speed and 8% Omnivamp for 6s. Empower your Basic Attacks to deal (+10%) Damage On-Hit for 6s.

Thraex (Eternal): Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).
Sun Shards (augment): Sparrow's basic attacks ricochet 1/2/3/4 times, dealing (+20%) Damage and applying On-Hit effects at 35% effectiveness.

Sustain: 7% lifesteal; Tainted Rounds: On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.; Savage Strikes: Deal 1.5 (+0.4 per level) Physical Damage On-Hit. Attacking an Enemy Hero increases this by 100% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times. Heal for the damage dealt.; 5,048 healing recorded.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 9 effects on one trigger: Lightning Hawk, Spectra, Tainted Rounds, Viper, Dust Devil, Eviscerator, Thraex, Savage Strikes, Sun Shards.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 3 effects on one trigger: Tainted Rounds, Eviscerator, Savage Strikes.
The Eternal was part of it: Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity) sits on the same triggers as the items (every basic attack set off; healing off the damage), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 2 of the 5 players Sparrow killed built physical armor (Adele, Khaimera). Anti-heal on Shinbi, Khaimera. We killed Sparrow 7 times.
Copy it? Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity): 50.3% in 674 Sparrow carry games, level with the hero's 50.3%. A standard setup: what made it work was this game, not a secret build.

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Wraith Leggings, Vesh, Mind Rot. Mourn has 3 damaging abilities (Beguile hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 45 ability haste brought them back 31% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 3 effects on one trigger: Devotion, Lifecore, Windcaller.
Stack (Finishing damage on low-health targets): 2 effects on one trigger: Devotion, Wraith Leggings. Once a fight started going their way, these finished it.
The Eternal was part of it: Vesh (Tithe of Death + Mind Rot) sits on the same trigger as the items (every ability hit set off), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 1 of the 4 players Mourn killed built magical armor (Adele). Anti-heal on Shinbi, Khaimera. We killed Mourn 6 times.
Copy it? Vesh: 53.7% in 607 Mourn support games, above the hero's 52.4%. Proven this patch: worth copying.
